title: English Fell from 75% of Web Pages—and Never Recovered
hook: English once filled 75% of web pages, then the world logged on.
closing: Searching only in English means seeing a narrower version of the internet.
question: Which language do you browse in?

segments.say: English filled 75 percent of web pages, before more of the world came online.
Arabic content grew 2,501 percent, showing how quickly the web expanded beyond English.
English now leads with 55 percent of websites, leaving nearly half in other languages.
